summary: Per-work golden queries: faithful retrieval eval grown by the corpus ritual
description:
Grow the golden retrieval eval by ritual: every corpus update ships per-work query files in guru-web, drafted from the work's chunks and owner-ratified in PR review.

Design constraints settled in the 2026-08-12 session (rellm docs/edges/query-scorer-rungs.md + edge-roadmap addendum):
- Two query kinds, kept separate. RECALL PROBES: written from a chunk's content in a reader's own words, distinctive vocabulary deliberately paraphrased (copied words make FTS hits self-fulfilling); assert only tradition/work survival into top-K, like the existing 7 tradition-anchored goldens. RELEVANCE QUERIES: conceptual questions the work answers that other traditions also answer; NO asserted target — graded post-hoc under the kappa +0.800 (query,chunk) judgment frame.
- Provenance chunk ids recorded on every query for audit, never asserted.
- Train/eval partition BY WORK from day one: a frozen work-disjoint golden subset, the rest eligible as a fine-tune query distribution (the scorer ladder's rung 3 is gated on exactly this).
- Per-work files fixtures/golden-queries/<work>.json aggregated by the test, so a corpus update touches only its own work's file; existing golden-retrieval.json stays as-is, corpus-version-pinned.

Why now: extends judgment power past 11 positives, unblocks the fine-tune query distribution, and queries arriving with the corpus cannot be cherry-picked toward the edge approach.
